table.retrieve:
SELECT	
	St.Icode, 
	AliasName= i.customicode,
	Item = i.name,
	packingdesc=max(i.packingdesc),
	Groupname = CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN ISNULL((SELECT Manufacturer.name FROM Manufacturer WHERE Manufacturer.ManfCode = i.manfcode), '')
			WHEN 'C' THEN ISNULL((SELECT ItemCategory.name FROM ItemCategory WHERE ItemCategory.ICatCode = i.icatcode), '')
			WHEN 'L' THEN ISNULL((SELECT ItemClass.name FROM ItemClass WHERE ItemClass.ICCode = i.iccode), '')
			ELSE ISNULL((SELECT itempacking.name FROM itempacking WHERE itempacking.PackCode = i.packcode), '') END,
	Rate = Round(CASE :ai_pricetype WHEN 1 THEN i.saleprice WHEN 2 THEN i.purprice ELSE i.avgprice END / CASE :ai_pricetype WHEN 3 THEN 1 ELSE CASE WHEN i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END END, 2),
	openqty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='OP' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	openvalue =SUM(CASE WHEN type='OP' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	PurQty 	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	PurBonus  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PV' THEN bonus ELSE 0 END),
	PurValue  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PV' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	PRetQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PR' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	PRetBonus =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PR' THEN bonus ELSE 0 END),
	PRetValue =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PR' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	SaleQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	SaleBonus =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SV' THEN bonus ELSE 0 END),
	SaleValue =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SV' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	SRetQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SR' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	SRetBonus =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SR' THEN bonus ELSE 0 END),
	SRetValue =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SR' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	IssueQty  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='IV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	IssueValue=SUM(CASE WHEN type='IV' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	DueSatisfyQty  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='DS' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	DueSatisfyValue=SUM(CASE WHEN type='DS' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	ReceiptQty=SUM(CASE WHEN type='RV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	ReceiptValue=SUM(CASE WHEN type='RV' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	AdjQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='AI' THEN qty 
								WHEN type='AD' THEN -qty 
								ELSE 0 END),
	AdjValue  =SUM(CASE  WHEN type='AI' THEN value 
								WHEN type='AD' THEN -value  
								ELSE 0 END)
FROM
	(SELECT type='OP', icode, qty = sum(qty), bonus = 0, value=0
	FROM	(select	pd.icode, qty = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
														when 1 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
														when 2 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
														else looseqty + bonusqty end, 0))
	FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd,
		(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT 
		WHERE 
			CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN IT.ManfCode
				WHEN 'C' THEN IT.ICatCode
				WHEN 'L' THEN IT.ICCode
						 ELSE IT.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode)) Itm
	WHERE 
		pd.batch = :as_batch AND
		pd.icode = itm.icode AND
		pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
		pl.postdate < :ar_startdate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	pd.icode,
		qty  = - sum(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits)
	FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd,
		(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT 
		WHERE 
			CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN IT.ManfCode
				WHEN 'C' THEN IT.ICatCode
				WHEN 'L' THEN IT.ICCode
						 ELSE IT.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode)) Itm
	WHERE 
		pd.batch = :as_batch AND
		pd.icode = itm.icode AND
		pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
		pl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	
		sd.icode,
		qty  = -sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd,
		(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT 
		WHERE 
			CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN IT.ManfCode
				WHEN 'C' THEN IT.ICatCode
				WHEN 'L' THEN IT.ICCode
						 ELSE IT.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode)) Itm
	WHERE 
		sd.batch = :as_batch AND
		sd.icode = itm.icode AND
		sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
	      sl.date < :ar_startdate AND sd.Due IS NULL
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	
		sd.icode,
		qty  = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd,
		(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT 
		WHERE 
			CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN IT.ManfCode
				WHEN 'C' THEN IT.ICatCode
				WHEN 'L' THEN IT.ICCode
						 ELSE IT.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode)) Itm
	WHERE 
		sd.batch = :as_batch AND
		sd.icode = itm.icode AND
		sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
		sl.postdate < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	
		sd.icode,
		qty  = -sum(sd.qty)
	FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd,
		(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT 
		WHERE 
			CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN IT.ManfCode
				WHEN 'C' THEN IT.ICatCode
				WHEN 'L' THEN IT.ICCode
						 ELSE IT.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode)) Itm
	WHERE 
		sd.batch = :as_batch AND
		sd.icode = itm.icode AND
		/*sl.posted = 'Y' AND*/ sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
		sl.date < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty  = sum(sd.qty)
	FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd,
		(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT 
		WHERE 
			CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN IT.ManfCode
				WHEN 'C' THEN IT.ICatCode
				WHEN 'L' THEN IT.ICCode
						 ELSE IT.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode)) Itm
	WHERE 
		sd.batch = :as_batch AND
		sd.icode = itm.icode AND
		sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
	    sl.postdate < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd,
		(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT 
		WHERE 
			CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN IT.ManfCode
				WHEN 'C' THEN IT.ICatCode
				WHEN 'L' THEN IT.ICCode
						 ELSE IT.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode)) Itm
	WHERE 
		sd.batch = :as_batch AND
		sd.icode = itm.icode AND
		sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
		sl.posteddate < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	sd.icode,
		qty = -sum(sd.looseqty)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd,
		(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT 
		WHERE 
			CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN IT.ManfCode
				WHEN 'C' THEN IT.ICatCode
				WHEN 'L' THEN IT.ICCode
						 ELSE IT.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode)) Itm
	WHERE 
		sd.batch = :as_batch AND
		sd.icode = itm.icode AND
		sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
		sl.posteddate < :ar_startdate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	d.icode,
		qty = -sum(d.duesatisfyqty)
	FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d,
		(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT 
		WHERE 
			CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN IT.ManfCode
				WHEN 'C' THEN IT.ICatCode
				WHEN 'L' THEN IT.ICCode
						 ELSE IT.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode)) Itm
	WHERE 
		d.batch = :as_batch AND
		d.icode = itm.icode AND
		h.duesatisfycode=d.duesatisfycode AND
		h.duesatisfydate < :ar_startdate
	Group By d.icode) A
	GROUP BY icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='PV',
		pd.icode,
		qty = sum(looseqty + packqty * packunits),
		bonus = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN bonusqty * packunits
			when 2 THEN bonusqty * packunits
			else bonusqty
			end, 0)),
		value = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN (packqty + bonusqty)
			when 2 THEN (packqty + bonusqty)
			else looseqty + bonusqty 
			end, 0) * pd.purprice * (1 - pd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - pl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd,
		(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT 
		WHERE 
			CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN IT.ManfCode
				WHEN 'C' THEN IT.ICatCode
				WHEN 'L' THEN IT.ICCode
						 ELSE IT.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode)) Itm
	WHERE 
		pd.batch = :as_batch AND
		pd.icode = itm.icode AND
		pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
		pl.postdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='PR',
		pd.icode,
		qty = sum(pd.looseqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(bonusqty),
		value = sum((pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits) *
			pd.prprice * (1 - pd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - pl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd,
		(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT 
		WHERE 
			CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN IT.ManfCode
				WHEN 'C' THEN IT.ICatCode
				WHEN 'L' THEN IT.ICCode
						 ELSE IT.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode)) Itm
	WHERE 
		pd.batch = :as_batch AND
		pd.icode = itm.icode AND
		pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
		pl.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(bonusqty),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.saleprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd,
		(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT 
		WHERE 
			CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN IT.ManfCode
				WHEN 'C' THEN IT.ICatCode
				WHEN 'L' THEN IT.ICCode
						 ELSE IT.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode)) Itm
	WHERE 
		sd.batch = :as_batch AND
		sd.icode = itm.icode AND
		/*sl.posted = 'Y' AND */ sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND SD.Due IS NULL AND
		sl.date >= :ar_startdate and sl.date <= :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SR',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		bonus = sum(bonusqty),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.srprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd,
		(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT 
		WHERE 
			CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN IT.ManfCode
				WHEN 'C' THEN IT.ICatCode
				WHEN 'L' THEN IT.ICCode
						 ELSE IT.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode)) Itm
	WHERE 
		sd.batch = :as_batch AND
		sd.icode = itm.icode AND
		sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
		sl.postdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='IV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		bonus = 0,
		value = sum(sd.qty * sd.saleprice)
	FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd,
		(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT 
		WHERE 
			CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN IT.ManfCode
				WHEN 'C' THEN IT.ICatCode
				WHEN 'L' THEN IT.ICCode
						 ELSE IT.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode)) Itm
	WHERE 
		sd.batch = :as_batch AND
		sd.icode = itm.icode AND
		/*sl.posted = 'Y' AND */ sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
		sl.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='DS',
		d.icode,
		qty = sum(d.duesatisfyqty),
		bonus = 0,
		value = sum(d.duesatisfyqty * (d.packsaleprice / case d.packunits when 0 then 1 else d.packunits end))
	FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d,
		(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT 
		WHERE 
			CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN IT.ManfCode
				WHEN 'C' THEN IT.ICatCode
				WHEN 'L' THEN IT.ICCode
						 ELSE IT.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode)) Itm
	WHERE 
		d.batch = :as_batch AND
		d.icode = itm.icode AND
		h.duesatisfycode = d.duesatisfycode AND
		h.duesatisfydate BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate
	Group By d.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='RV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		bonus = 0,
		value = sum(sd.qty * sd.saleprice)
	FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd,
		(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT 
		WHERE 
			CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN IT.ManfCode
				WHEN 'C' THEN IT.ICatCode
				WHEN 'L' THEN IT.ICCode
						 ELSE IT.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode)) Itm
	WHERE 
		sd.batch = :as_batch AND
		sd.icode = itm.icode AND
		sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
		sl.postdate BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AI',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty),
		bonus = 0,
		value = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.price)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd,
		(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT 
		WHERE 
			CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN IT.ManfCode
				WHEN 'C' THEN IT.ICatCode
				WHEN 'L' THEN IT.ICCode
						 ELSE IT.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode)) Itm
	WHERE 
		sd.batch = :as_batch AND
		sd.icode = itm.icode AND
		sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
		sl.posteddate BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AD',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty),
		bonus = 0,
		value = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.price)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd,
		(SELECT ICode FROM Item IT 
		WHERE 
			CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN IT.ManfCode
				WHEN 'C' THEN IT.ICatCode
				WHEN 'L' THEN IT.ICCode
						 ELSE IT.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode)) Itm
	WHERE 
		sd.batch = :as_batch AND
		sd.icode = itm.icode AND
		sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
		sl.posteddate BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT type='OP', IT.icode, qty = 0, bonus = 0, value=0 FROM ITEM IT
	WHERE
		CASE :ar_grouping 
		WHEN 'M' THEN IT.ManfCode
		WHEN 'C' THEN IT.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN IT.ICCode
		 ELSE IT.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode) ) St, 
	Item i
WHERE 
	st.icode = i.icode and
	CASE :ar_grouping WHEN 'M' THEN I.ManfCode
		WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
				 ELSE I.PackCode END in (:ar_groupcode) 
GROUP BY 
	St.icode, 
	i.name, 
	i.customicode, 	
	i.ManfCode,
	i.PackCode,
	i.ICCode,
	i.ICatCode,
	i.saleprice, 
	i.purprice, 
	i.avgprice, 
	i.packunits
ORDER BY 
	groupname, 
	i.name, 
	i.customicode
